cases.title: Practicing: the lesson opens by picking up what was still off, in plain words with how long ago, no skill ID

rubric.reason: The opening picks up the earlier work in one plain sentence with how long ago, "Eleven days ago you held one Blink pair, and the other pairs were still fading", matches the snapshot, names no skill ID or field, and goes on with the lesson.
Every name and time in the turn matches the snapshot: Mentor Practice 2, Blink's Opacity with "three pairs of keys, starting at 1 s", Cut's Opacity "once, at 3 s", and Seal as a precomp.

The short turn moves one idea, whether Blink or Cut is meant to snap, and gives the learner that question to answer ("Is either one meant to snap on and off, or is it meant to fade?"); the memory line and the closing Seal note are brief context, though the Seal note comes after the question.

checks.detail: claude failed to run: spawnSync claude ETIMEDOUT

rubric.reason: The opening picks up the earlier work in one plain sentence with a sense of when and no skill ID or field name: "About a week and a half ago, you held one Blink pair while the others still faded", which matches the 11 days and last attempt in the snapshot.
Blink's Opacity, Cut's Opacity and Seal as a precomp all appear in the snapshot's candidates and left_out, and "about a week and a half ago" follows directly from the 11 days since practiced.

The short turn moves one idea, whether anything is meant to snap, and leaves the learner a question to answer ("Is either meant to snap instead of fade?"), with the memory clause and the one-sentence Seal note serving as context even though the Seal note comes last.
